entities.summary: Roy Frank Drusky, Jr. was an American country music singer and songwriter popular from the 1960s through the early 1970s. Known for his baritone voice, he was known for incorporating the Nashville sound and for being one of the first artists to record a song written by Kris Kristofferson. His highest-charting single was the number-one "Yes, Mr. Peters", a duet with Priscilla Mitchell.
